verdict.rationale: Docs claim the SDK exposes 'the same tools, agent loop, and context management that power Claude Code' plus built-in tools, hooks, subagents, MCP, permissions, sessions, and structured outputs — a broad feature set mirroring the CLI/UI experience. However, community reports describe recent policy changes restricting subscription-based access when using the SDK (forcing API billing) and complaints about the default harness's poor observability/extensibility, indicating real friction rather than clean, unrestricted API=UI parity. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of full feature parity, and clarity on how billing/access-tier restrictions affect true API/UI equivalence.
